punchline: Mendel explained heredity in 1865, and it took until 1900 for others to build on it.
thirty_sec: A friar in Brno grew peas and saw that traits pass on in separate units, round or wrinkled, gone in one generation and back in the next. He told the local natural history society in 1865 and the paper was printed in 1866. It was largely overlooked until 1900, when three researchers reached the same results on their own and found it.
